SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS o JOIN MEMBER m ON o.member_id = m.id WHERE o.status IN ('PLACED', 'PAID', 'READY', 'SHIPPING')
AND m.church_id = #{churchId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GOODS_ITEM WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND stock <= noti_qty

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTION s JOIN MEMBER m ON s.member_id = m.id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND m.church_id = #{churchId}

SELECT u.source_id AS source_id, u.kind AS kind, u.status AS status, u.amount AS amount, u.member_name AS member_name, u.occurred_at AS occurred_at FROM ( (SELECT o.id AS source_id, 'ORDER' AS kind, o.status AS status, o.total AS amount, om.name AS member_name, o.ordered_at AS occurred_at FROM ORDERS o JOIN MEMBER om ON o.member_id = om.id WHERE o.ordered_at >= #{since} AND om.church_id = #{churchId} ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT s.id AS source_id, 'SUBSCRIPTION' AS kind, s.status AS status, NULL AS amount, sm.name AS member_name, s.started_at AS occurred_at FROM SUBSCRIPTION s JOIN MEMBER sm ON s.member_id = sm.id WHERE s.started_at >= #{since} AND sm.church_id = #{churchId} ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT d.id AS source_id, 'DONATION' AS kind, d.type AS status, d.amount AS amount, dm.name AS member_name, d.paid_at AS occurred_at FROM DONATION d JOIN MEMBER dm ON d.member_id = dm.id WHERE d.status = 'PAID' AND d.paid_at >= #{since} AND dm.church_id = #{churchId} ORDER BY d.paid_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT mm.id AS source_id, 'MEMBER' AS kind, mm.user_status AS status, NULL AS amount, mm.name AS member_name, mm.created_at AS occurred_at FROM MEMBER mm WHERE mm.created_at >= #{since} AND mm.church_id = #{churchId} ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC, mm.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) ) u ORDER BY u.occurred_at DESC, u.source_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
